rows.estimation_basis: Estimates are grounded in reference project '001-logistics-fleet-portal' (3,400 total hours across 20 weeks for 600+ vehicles and 3 telematics vendors). Scope has been calibrated down: telematics integration is scoped for 2 vendors rather than 3 (320-420 hours vs. 520 hours in reference), and the fleet size of 300 vans reduces load complexity compared to the 600-vehicle reference. Key lessons learned around vendor API variance and decoupled queue ingestion have been directly incorporated into the integration scope and technical risk mitigation strategy.

No reference projects were provided for this proposal. Estimates are derived based on general engineering experience with geospatial microservices, WebSocket ingestion pipelines, and multi-vendor REST/webhook integration architectures.

Estimates are directly grounded in historical data from reference project 'KYC Onboarding Platform for a Digital Bank' (id=002-fintech-kyc-onboarding, total 5,200 hours over 26 weeks). The core functional modules (document capture, IDV integration, sanctions/PEP screening, compliance review console, rules engine, GDPR/PII security, and extensive QA/regulatory sign-off) align closely with the reference architecture. Hours have been calibrated into min-max ranges around the historical benchmarks to account for specific vendor integration nuances and compliance hardening requirements.

No reference projects were provided. Estimates are derived from general engineering experience with fintech onboarding flows, third-party identity verification API integrations, and banking compliance requirements. Scope accounts for rigorous automated testing, audit trail guarantees, and data protection hardening.

Estimates are directly derived from historical performance data in reference project 'B2B Marketplace for Industrial Parts' (id=003-ecommerce-b2b-marketplace, 6,100 total hours, 30 weeks). The core architectural components—including catalogue ingestion pipelines, Elasticsearch querying, customer-specific pricing, Stripe Connect split disbursements, supplier portal, SSR SEO optimization, and QA—were matched against historical baseline modules. Scope adjustments were applied: enterprise punch-out integrations (cXML/OCI, historical 480h) were omitted as they were not required for this building materials wholesaler, and catalogue feed import effort was moderately adjusted from 620h to 520-600h to focus strictly on CSV and XML ingestion workflows rather than dynamic third-party API feeds. This brings the revised engineering baseline to approximately 4,770 - 5,560 total hours over a targeted 27-week timeline.
No reference projects were provided; estimates are based on general experience delivering enterprise B2B marketplace platforms, custom data ingestion pipelines, and multi-party payment systems.

Estimates are directly benchmarked against Reference Project 004-healthcare-patient-app (Patient Appointment and Telehealth App: 3,900 total hours, 22 weeks), which delivered a comparable Flutter mobile application, FastAPI backend, Twilio video consultations, scheduling, and HIPAA-compliant infrastructure. Feature scopes for scheduling (450-540h vs. 520h historical) and video consultations (320-400h vs. 380h historical) align with proven historical baselines. EHR/FHIR integration hours from the reference project were adapted to accommodate a standard dental Practice Management System (PMS) integration layer (360-460h vs. 480h historical).

No reference projects were provided. Estimates are derived based on general engineering experience with healthcare web and mobile applications, accounting for HIPAA audit logging, WebRTC video consultation integration, multi-location scheduling, and secure cloud infrastructure.

Estimates are directly benchmarked against historical data from reference project 'Internal HR Knowledge Assistant (RAG) (id=005-hr-internal-ai-assistant)' which totaled 1,500 hours over 10 weeks for a 400-document corpus. For this engagement, scope was adjusted upward for a larger legal corpus of 800 documents (+20-30 hours in ingestion and data modeling) and significantly more stringent legal document-level ACL filtering, auditing, and precision validation (+40-50 hours across search and QA). Conversely, core retrieval and SSO foundations remain closely aligned with the reference project's proven delivery baseline, yielding an estimated 1,340 - 1,640 engineering hours delivered across an 11-week schedule.

Work breakdown assumes an experienced team of 1 Senior Full-Stack/Angular Engineer, 1 Senior AI/Backend Engineer, and 1 Solution Architect/DevOps Engineer collaborating across an iterative 10-week delivery schedule.

Estimates are directly benchmarked against Reference Project 008 (Offline-First Field Service App for Technicians), which required 3,600 total engineering hours over 21 weeks across an identical functional scope (offline data layer, mobile forms, photo/signature upload queue, dispatch console, ERP integration, notifications, and pilot validation). Historical findings from Project 008 demonstrated that conflict resolution and sync edge cases represented the largest source of defects; therefore, sync was allocated as its own high-complexity epic with an integrated ~25% buffer reflected in the 720-840 hour range. Adjustments reflect modern native tooling (React Native + SQLite) alongside robust queuing architectures.

Estimates are directly anchored in Reference Project id=008-mobile-field-service (3,600 total hours, 21 weeks). We mapped their offline data layer (760h) and adjusted to 420-540h because courier delivery status flow is primarily append-only compared to complex bi-directional field technician forms and checklists. Photo and signature capture with upload queuing closely mirrors 008's PoD scope (300h benchmarked against our 240-300h). The 008 scheduling and dispatch console (640h) was adapted into the real-time map console (320-420h) plus delay alerting engine (160-220h). Complex ERP integration (520h in 008) was excluded as it was not requested, while effort was reallocated toward battery-optimized background GPS tracking and streaming geospatial telemetry.

Estimates are grounded in historical metrics from reference project 008-mobile-field-service (total 3,600 hours over 21 weeks). This delivers an accelerated, focused 16-week timeline targeting high-reliability offline checklists and head-office analytics.
